children: Clariane signed an unsecured, unguaranteed €700M syndicated revolving credit facility maturing in five years, replacing its prior RCF, with an accordion up to €900M and margin of EURIBOR +1.75%–3.50% tied to leverage and ESG KPIs.
Material Details
Detail
AI Analyst View
New €700M unsecured RCF, 5-year term
Enhances liquidity and refinancing flexibility through 2031.
Accordion option up to €900M
Provides additional headroom if needed without new docs.
Pricing: EURIBOR +1.75%–3.50%
Cost of capital tied to leverage; impacts interest expense.
Leverage covenant ≤7.0x to Jun-2027
Covenant headroom vs 5.4x pro forma reduces risk.
ESG margin adj ±6 bps
Small pricing swing tied to KPI performance.
Dividend cap: 7% of market cap
Limits payouts unless leverage ≤4.5x; prioritizes de-levering.
Context by AI Analyst

This extends and replaces liquidity after a recent €500M bond issue, advancing balance-sheet stabilization. A bigger catalyst would be deleveraging toward the 4.5x threshold, refinancing progress, or improved margins lowering RCF pricing.
